title: BG graph disappear upon sensor start (Libre bluetooth)
body:
### Subject of the issue
After starting a new sensor BG graph disappeared. Main screen and history.

### Your environment
- 20210115 and other user 20210108
- L2 + Bubble + OOP1 and other user L1 + miaomiao

### Expected behavior
See BG dots

### Actual behavior
BG is displayed with trend arrow, history populates with statistics, but BG dots are not displayed.
DB backup restore no change. Reboot phone no change.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior:
Stop sensor
Start new sensor after 1 hour warm-up

### Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem. Please do not add oversized screenshots!
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33809361/105089785-dd0e4f80-5a9d-11eb-88e7-24a3406a5469.png)

comments.body:
Ooops that was an oversized screenshot. Here are mine. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33809361/105092328-5eb3ac80-5aa1-11eb-926e-2f81140f395c.png)

Tried to uninstall and reinstall xDrip+, restored settings and database from backup. Issue persists.
Then tried an empty database with setting. Same.
Then restored only the database and said no to settings. Worked! By some sort of black magic, settings were also restored correctly even if I always answered No to xDrip+ requests.
Found one good reason. Show Libre Trend does that.
Hence, it was a setting which was not enabled?

No, it was a setting that was enabled and decided to go rogue. I tried to enable it on my sync follower and checking it just closed xDrip+. Note the master runs OOP1 so I'm not sure Libre trend is available. But since the other user doesn't use an OOP it might be something else. Enabling Libre Trend on the master hides all dots, disabling it they come back.

Do we know how to recreate this problem?
Is there something we need to fix in xDrip with respect to this?
